name: Charlie Crist
pollingDetails: St. Pete Polls, Oct 13 2026, 419 likely St. Petersburg voters, MoE ±4.8: Crist 50%, Welch 32%, undecided 18%; with leaners Crist 53%, Welch 32% (per Florida Politics). Florida Politics' Oct 26 Sunburn cited a third post-primary St. Pete Polls survey at Crist 51%-32% (54%-34% with leaners). An Aug 31-Sep 1 St. Pete Polls survey (509 LV, ±4.3) had Crist 52%-27%. Caveat: every public poll is from St. Pete Polls, some sponsored by Florida Politics or the pro-Crist St. Pete Shines committee; Welch has disputed the pollster's accuracy.
lgbtqDetails: Endorsed by Equality Florida Action PAC and HRC in his 2014 and 2022 runs for governor after reversing his earlier support (as Republican governor) for Florida's 2008 same-sex marriage ban. In this race the LGBTQ+ groups (Equality Florida Action PAC, Stonewall Democrats of Pinellas) endorsed Welch; at the Oct 13 debate Crist said he would have sued the state over the Pride mural removal (Watermark Out News).
platform: Former Republican governor (2007-11), Democratic U.S. representative (2017-22) and two-time Democratic nominee for governor, now seeking the strong-mayor post in his hometown. Runs on affordability, a sharper hurricane-recovery operation (dedicated storm-permit team, fee waivers, pre-signed recovery contracts), a 'people-first' slower process for the 86-acre Historic Gas Plant District (and floated a renewed Rays push), protecting public safety if Amendment 3 passes, and a consumer-advocate lens on the Duke Energy municipalization study.
